objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Locally defined or business process-related regulations and instructions

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Specific procedures within a framework describing process sequence and responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed work steps for sub-processes with compliance criteria and forms

objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed object with properties, versions, and release control

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to release cycle of main document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document that is released with main document and affects versioning

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Suggested amendment to existing document without affecting version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request to check document validity after defined period

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate previously invalidated document

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to receive document releases

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Grouped set of users with shared access rights

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature applied by workflow participants on documents

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: System record of all document changes and actions

objs.name: document_reader
objs.description: Role with permission to view approved documents

objs.name: document_author
objs.description: Role with read and write permissions on document and related objects

objs.name: document_reviewer
objs.description: Role responsible for technical and formal checking of documents

objs.name: document_releaser
objs.description: Role responsible for approving document distribution to readers

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role with permission to translate released documents to other languages

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of new information object with document type selection and template

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content with automatic PDF conversion

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Update of document properties and attributes in categorized sections

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Definition of reader groups and personal roles for document access

evts.name: initiate_release_process
evts.description: Start of workflow-supported approval process by author or co-author

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature by workflow participant completing their task

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of document after successful release

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of new editing version when released document is revised

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking attachment for archiving when no longer relevant to new version

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of suggested amendment to document by author with rights

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Acceptance of change proposal creating new document version

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System creation of workflow request for document validity check

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declaration of additional validity by releaser or release team

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new version when validity extension check determines revision needed

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiation of workflow to invalidate document with no additional validity

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Approval workflow marking document and attachments as invalid

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Revocation of all authorizations except archive group after override

evts.name: delete_document_physically
evts.description: Physical removal of document after archive period expiration

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiation of workflow to re-validate archived document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirmation of reactivation creating new version of archived document

evts.name: maintain_distribution
evts.description: Assignment of user groups and persons to distribution list

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: Automatic email to distribution list on document version release

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic workflow-supported request for users to confirm document receipt

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Completion of acknowledgement task by distribution list recipient

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content to another language

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Workflow-supported approval of translated document version

o2o.description: Document has controlled attachments released together
Document is subject of change proposals
Validity extension request is linked to document for validity check
Override request is created for document to be invalidated
Reactivation request targets previously invalidated document
Distribution list is maintained for document recipients
Document has audit trail recording all changes and actions
Distribution list contains assigned user groups

o2e.description: Document is created as new information object
Document content is edited and converted to PDF
Document properties and attributes are maintained
Document access roles and groups are assigned
Release workflow is started for document
Document is automatically published after release
New version is created when released document is revised
Attachment is marked for archiving
Change proposal is created for document amendment
Change proposal is accepted creating new document version
System generates validity extension request
Validity extension request is processed to extend document validity
Document is revised when validity check determines revision needed
Override request is created to invalidate document
Override request is approved declaring document invalid
Document authorizations are revoked after override declaration
Document is physically deleted after archive period expiration
Reactivation request is created for archived document
Reactivation request is approved creating new document version
Distribution list is created and maintained for document
Email notification is sent to user groups on release
Acknowledgement request is sent to user group members
User group members confirm acknowledgement of document
Document is translated to another language
Translation of document is approved and released
Electronic signature is applied to document by workflow participant
